detail: A seven-dimensional packed-weight/shared tensor was rejected by TileLang layout inference because the selected global-to-shared slice was not TMA-capable. The physical layout was flattened to a previously validated 8 KiB N64 TMA box.

consumer_max_nreg=160 with 512 consumer threads waited indefinitely for Hopper dynamic register reallocation after the producer warpgroup released its allocation. The process was terminated after read-only PID/GPU checks; the transposed path now rejects register budgets above 112.

N128/global-split-K1 was correct at 0.3284571 ms but launched only 64 main CTAs on the 132-SM H200. N128/global-split-K2 restored 128 main CTAs and reached 0.1740439 ms; N64/CTA-local-split-K4 avoided the reducer and was selected as the frozen inner mapping.
